state.cv: Nora Walsh Administration and Reporting Coordinator @ nora.walsh.cv@example.ie  +353 80 000 0044  Dublin, Ireland Practical skills Excel · spreadsheet checks · basic charts · action tracking · document coordination · scheduling · Microsoft 365 Languages English: native Irish: basic Community Volunteer coordinator for a community repair café; maintains bookings and welcomes visitors. Profile Senior administrator experienced with records, schedules and service requests. Interested in using basic data to make follow-up clearer; careful with spreadsheets and checks. Experience **Operations Administrator — Liffey Support Network** *2023–Present* Maintains shared service logs and checks unresolved requests have an owner and next step. Prepares weekly summaries of request volume and common follow-up reasons. Helped redesign a tracker separating new requests from cases waiting on external information. **Project Administrator, contract — Beacon Facilities Group** *2021–2023* Scheduled meetings, maintained action lists and compiled project status notes. Checked invoices and supporting documents before routing for approval. **Office Coordinator — Fairview Community Hub** *2017–2021* Managed room bookings and reception cover; helped standardize handover notes between part-time staff. Selected project Created a monthly spreadsheet for a community repair café to record bookings, repair categories and repeat issues. The tracker helps volunteers plan parts and capacity; it is not a predictive system. Education and availability Further education coursework in office administration, Dublin (2008–2009). Full- time; hybrid preference in Dublin.
